title: Grand Blue Dreaming
description: A college student joins the local diving club after meeting some rowdy upperclassmen. New adventures in booze and the ocean await.

episodes.title: S2-E5First Time at a Women's University
S2-E11Let's Go to an Uninhabited Island!

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: When Iori Kitahara heads off to college, he decides to live at his uncle's dive shop in Izu. Iori is looking forward to experiencing college life, but ends up running into a group of tough guys playing strip rock-paper-scissors. Iori gets dragged into the diving club's crazy shenanigans and ends up spending his first day in college wearing nothing but a pair of underwear.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: After a cutthroat battle with Kohei Imamura, a handsome otaku from school, Iori ends up joining the Peek-a-Boo diving club. Iori arrives home worn out from the day, but perks up when he hears about a party with a women's college. However, his cousin Nanaka won't allow him to stay out three nights in a row, so Iori tries to show her he's an independent man to get her to let him go.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Iori and Kohei don wetsuits and head to the sea! Although Iori used to be afraid of the water, he starts becoming more interested. But diving equipment is expensive! Tokita and Kotobuki decide to hold a men's beauty pageant for the Izu Spring Festival in May. The guys want to avoid being paraded around on stage, so they try to get Chisa to participate in a women's beauty pageant.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The Izu Spring Festival has begun! The members of Peek-a-Boo run an okonomiyaki stall with Iori, Kohei, Chisa, and Azusa helping out. Iori finds himself in a complicated situation when a misunderstanding with Azusa occurs and a rivalry with the tennis club Tinkerbell begins. When Chisa gets nervous and freezes up during the women's beauty pageant, Iori and Kohei think of a plan to cheer her on.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Iori and Kohei attend class in their underwear like normal, but everyone glares at them with a bloodthirsty look in their eyes! It's because they heard that Iori and Chisa are dating! Sensing their lives are in danger, Iori and Kohei offer to setup a mixer. They ask Azusa to introduce her friends, but she brings Aina Yoshiwara, the "Cakey" girl from the Izu Spring Festival!

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Inori and Kohei get through their exams by cheating. Meanwhile, PaB throws a welcome party for Aina, their new member. Aina was looking forward to getting a new start to college life, but discovers that no one in the club is normal! Nevertheless, the club members are serious about diving and have the new members learn basic hand signals and dive in pairs. However, Iori gets paired up with Chisa.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Iori and the others dream about going diving at a beautiful location after seeing an article on Miyakojima in a magazine. However, Tokita and Kotobuki decide the club is going to join a tennis doubles match! They explain that they're joining the match to get everyone to build trust with their diving buddy, but the real reason is to get back at the tennis club and take away their prize money!

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: The members of the diving team start working part-time jobs to pay for their trip to Okinawa. However, Iori and Kohei end up spending all their earnings on drinking. Meanwhile, Kotobuki is working hard as a bartender, and his boss lets Iori and Kohei try it out too. However, these two idiots don't know how to make cocktails, and end up creating some dangerous new drinks!

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Iori tries to setup another mixer for his friends, and wants to ask Chisa to introduce her friends so they can all play truth or dare. Nanaka and Azusa also get involved, and they all begin a vicious game of attack and defense! However, Iori doesn't have enough money for their trip. Iori and the gang head to a diving shop to buy diving gear, but find out there's still a lot they don't know.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The Peek-a-Boo members arrive in Okinawa! After checking out their gorgeous vacation home, the group decides to head to the beach. In order to make sure the guys don't try to get naked, they decide to go to a popular beach with lots of visitors, where they have some wild fun on a banana boat. However, Iori loses their banana boat contest and ends up having to sleep in Nanaka and Azusa's room!

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: "You might be the only one who can't pass the license test," Nanaka says to Iori, pointing out what he's bad at. To avoid being made fun of by Kohei and Nanaka, he practices secretly. Yet, while practice, all he thinks of is how to poison them at dinner. He avoids being pairs with Kohei and Aina and gets Chisa to promise to help him with practice. But, these interactions cause misunderstandings...

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: For the last half of their trip, the Peek-A-Boo members arrive in Miyakojima. Everyone goes for a serious dive into the majestic sea with the exception of Iori, who couldn't obtain his license. Everything is magical with the stunning coral reef, colorful fishes and sea turtles, until the members engage in PaB-style Otori (a drinking custom of Miyakojima), which turns things into a living hell...

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Iori receives a letter from his little sister back home. Note: This is still a diving anime.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Shiori's here and on a mission! How will Iori handle this situation?

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Aina is out of control! But why?

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Aina has a spare ticket for the Oumi Women's University Festival, and it causes all sorts of chaos.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Iori and Kohei attend the All-Girls College Festiva, but the girls ask them to help out at the cafe.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: After being expelled from college, the boys devise various plans to get back into it.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Iori and his class need to cooperate and do a very dangerous experiment together.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Iori runs into a familiar face at his new part-time job, and this is going to complicate matters!

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: All sorts of misunderstandings ensue as attraction comes into the equation.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Iori is asked out on a movie date, and he hears some news that complicates things.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: The gang heads out to a camping site on an uninhabited island, only to run into some unexpected faces.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 2 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Iori learns that a lot will soon change for the club.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Summer is coming to an end, and the older kids at the club want to do the things they still have left to do.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Iori and the gang head to his family home to grab his passport for the upcoming trip.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Iori must navigate Shiori, the tourists, and the stalker on the loose to get his hands on his passport.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The group eagerly arrives in Palau, where someone they know well is waiting for them.

episodes_data.title: Grand Blue Dreaming Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: A TV crew has arrived to film a special at Dolphin, and the gang gets roped into it!
